title: Collaborative Whiteboard
dek: Sceneledger, a shared online whiteboard I built for small teams' live design reviews: a React drawing app, a FastAPI server with accounts and live WebSocket sessions, and a PostgreSQL database. This page runs its editor and every order two people's simultaneous edits can reach each screen.
summary: Two people recolour one note at once: in 6 of the 8 possible orderings a screen shows a colour the database lacks; numbered order fixes all 8.
